question: What claim about the range of languages is being made with respect to what has and has not been heard?
premises: Languages of varied forms are present in this context.
Some of those forms are heard while others remain unheard.
The distinction between heard and unheard is asserted together.
inference: Languages of varied forms include both those that are heard and those that are unheard.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether the distinction is perceptual or ontological.
plain_english: Languages of varied forms indeed arise, both heard and unheard.
